# Mermaid

`mermaid.min.js` is Mermaid **11.4.1**, downloaded from
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mermaid@11.4.1/dist/mermaid.min.js
(2,571,900 bytes upstream). Download approved in foreman decision
`befa2d9d-b3ea-47a4-9065-285d90f533b9` on 2026-10-22.

The final global assignment is replaced with an ES module default export so
esbuild can import the bundle. The rest of the upstream file is unchanged.
License notices are retained in the bundle. No CDN is used at runtime.
